statement_summary: Group CISO and CPSO accountable; DCC HIPAA security official designated
Annual SP 800-30 risk analysis per division with roll-up to group
Risk acceptance authority by level; High patient-safety risks must be treated
Division supplements may not weaken group policy; re-align within 90 days; annual attestation
Divisions document common control inheritance annually; acquired sites onboarded within 12 months
SPDF for every device and related system; SBOM in every build; HSM-only signing after 2027-03-31
PSIRT operates CVD, monitors every marketed product including legacy, keeps ISAO membership
Third-party terms by data type: BAA, FAR flowdown, SBOM clauses, client confidentiality
Annual common control assessment; signed independence statement for intercompany tests
Six-year retention of security documentation; QMS schedule where longer
AI systems registered and approved under the Group AI Standard
regulatory_driver: FDA AI-enabled device software guidance (draft); FTC Act Sec. 5

statement_summary: Unique identities; no shared accounts on test stations or handhelds
Least privilege with owner approval; export screening for controlled technology
Information barrier between Testing and Medical Devices enforced in SYS-G1
MFA for all workforce; phishing-resistant for administrators and key custodians
Service and pipeline identities owned; workload identity or 90-day rotation
Access disabled within 4 hours of termination; guest accounts expire
Quarterly certification including privileged, signing, service, and guest accounts
Just-in-time privileged access through PAM; two custodians per signature
Vendor access to plants, automation, and laboratories only through PAM
MFA for hospital DCC administrators, Testing clients, and portal administrators
Physical access limited; visitors escorted and recorded
Report suspected incidents within 1 hour; device reports routed to the PSIRT
One severity scale for IT and product incidents
Log every clock-starting date (vulnerability, MDR awareness, breach discovery, 889 identification, correction)
Documented FDA decisions for every product incident; distributor complaints forwarded the same day
DCC four-factor breach assessment and hospital notices per BAA
Notification matrix with BAA, NDA, and federal contract terms; counsel approves notices
Severity 1 to disclosure committee within 24 hours; Form 8-K Item 1.05 within 4 business days of materiality
Annual cross-division exercise with a product incident and a materiality decision
Encrypt Restricted information; HSM-held signing keys
Testing client data only in LIMS, portal, or vault; never in cross-division spaces
PHI and export-control scanning of Testing submissions
Federal contract information only in the FCI enclave; flowdown before sharing
Immutable separate-provider backups with quarterly restore tests, including plant MES
Media sanitized or destroyed with a certificate
No Restricted data in AI tools without approval, no-training terms, and client consent
Annual training and quarterly phishing
Secure development and custody training before pipeline or signing access
Approved generative AI tools only; no code, vulnerabilities, PHI, client data, or FCI in public tools
Legacy products stay in PSIRT monitoring until end of support; end-of-support dates in labeling
regulatory_driver: FDA postmarket guidance (2016); FDA premarket guidance VI.A

statement_summary: Plant production zones, individual operator sign-in, MES logs to the SIEM
DCC 164.402 assessment for product incidents; BAA terms register
Annual CMMC Level 1 self-assessment and SPRS affirmation
Covered telecommunications inventory and 1-business-day report
Cyber prompts in complaint intake; importer reports within 30 days
Barrier groups, no shared spaces, quarterly attestations
Independence statement for every Medical Devices engagement
